column3: NASB renders “will be present” as “will come.”
NASB renders “implacable” as “irreconcilable,” “slanderous” as “malicious gossips,” “savage” as “brutal,” and “without love of good” as “haters of good.”
NASB adds “although” and renders “turn away from” as “avoid.”
NASB follows the critical text (“captivate”); “burdened” is rendered “weighed down,” and “passions” is “impulses.”
NASB renders “plain” as “obvious” and adds “two came to be.”
NASB follows the critical text (“followed”); “endurance” is rendered “perseverance.”
NASB renders “will advance to the worse” as “will proceed from bad to worse.”
NASB follows the critical text (“from whom”); “were assured of” is rendered “become convinced of.”
NASB renders “to make you wise” as “to give you the wisdom that leads.”
NASB renders “God-breathed” as “inspired by God,” “instruction” as “teaching,” and “conviction” as “reproof.”
NASB renders “complete” as “adequate” and “fully equipped” as “equipped.”
